EmailTemplate.description: Send email from Quote page to merge buyer name and quote #
EmailTemplate.name: Quote Follow Up with Customer
EmailTemplate.subject: Following up on Quote #{!QuotesOrdersCredits_Header__c.Name}
EmailTemplate.textOnly:
Hi {!QuotesOrdersCredits_Header__c.Buyer_First_Name__c},
Thank you for the quote opportunity. In regards to quote #{!QuotesOrdersCredits_Header__c.Name}, do you have any additional feedback or job information (I.E. For bid or buy, date required, pricing feedback, etc.)?
Any and all information would be greatly appreciated. Please let me know if there is anything else I can do for you.
Have a great day,
{!User.Full_Name__c}
